messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: APAC hybrid co-sell demo — proposed evening window for CloudForge

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the intro call yesterday. CloudForge's customers are a great fit for Redwood Dedicated + Private routing examples, and we'd love to put together a short hybrid co-sell demo that highlights: topology (VPC/private deploy), cost/latency profile, and a short Q&A on compliance (SOC2/retention).

Two compact windows we can offer next week (SGT/HKT times):
- Tue Jul 13, 09:00–10:00 SGT (morning APAC)
- Wed Jul 14, 18:00–19:00 SGT (evening APAC / overlapping US EOD)

If neither works, tell me a couple of times that fit for your engineering and procurement folks and we will accommodate. Could you also confirm which CloudForge attendees you want on the call (engineering, procurement, security)? We included a one-page draft agenda — see attached (draft-agenda.pdf).

Plan is a 30–45 minute demo + 15 minutes for procurement/security Q&A. Vanessa will run the demo narrative and Karthik can cover model routing and infra assumptions.

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0126

Attachment: draft-agenda.pdf (1 page)

Rishi —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the agenda. The team is excited. Quick note on availability: the July 13 morning slot conflicts with a customer briefing and our engineering leads are out for a sprint. The July 14 evening slot looks promising but can we shift it slightly earlier to 17:00–18:00 SGT instead of 18:00? That gives us more runway before internal day-end.

Attendees I expect to join: myself (eng sponsor), Mei Chen (product lead) and our procurement alias (procurement@cloudforge.com). If you want a security lead, I can try to loop in Nisha but it may be just procurement for now.

Also, when you say "hybrid" — are you planning to demo Hosted API + a quick Dedicated routing example? If you can surface the expected infra (whether we need firewall rules or a test VPC) that'd be helpful.

Thanks —
Samir

Head of Partnerships
